test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: What is the present worth of Rs. 1,100 due in 2 years at 5% simple interest per annum?
solution: Given: Amount (A) = Rs. 1,100 Time(T) = 2 years Rate of simple interest per annum(R) = 5% Formula used: Simple interest(SI) = (P × R × T) / 100 SI = A - P
